title: Santa Monica Pier Bridge Construction Updates: Moomat Ahiko Way off-ramp
description:
Construction on the new Santa Monica Pier Bridge continues. From now through Feb. 27, the Moomat Ahiko Way off-ramp from southbound Pacific Coast Highway will be temporarily closed to allow crews to build the foundation for a temporary pedestrian bridge.

Crews are also constructing a temporary pedestrian bridge and vehicle ramp to maintain access to the Pier during construction.

Access to the Pier and Pier businesses will remain open during construction.

Plan ahead and follow posted detours.

Find more information at santamonica.gov/pierbridge
